title: feat(spec): a named import mapping's label is translatable at mappings.NAME.label
body:
Fixes #34939

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #34962 (skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md group list)

Claim: issuecomment-6956466284, seat amendment issuecomment-6957676841 (route A: label only, packaged-base guard in, description out). This PR is part (1) of the card. Parts (2) and (3), the import wizard's mapping step and preview, are in the UI-half PR #34961. Both are needed to close the card's three symptoms.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 翻译包新增 `mappings` 分组，只有一个键 `mappings.NAME.label`。`GET /meta/mapping`（列表与单条）按读者语言返回已命名导入映射的标签。`os i18n extract` / `os i18n check` / `os validate`、Studio 翻译预览与翻译表都认识这个分组。
- **为什么改：** zh-CN 组织里，导入向导按标签列出已保存映射，但标签是映射上的纯字符串，翻译包里没有对应的键，所以每种语言都显示作者原文（如 `Inquiry feed (marketing CSV)`）。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯加宽：新增可选分组与新翻译器，原来能解析的都照常通过。覆盖包里被改过的标签按 ADR-0146 D2 判定，与 book/page 相同。回滚即还原本 PR。`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 在 main 上恰好处于门面行数上限 11705。按席位裁决（路线 B），把 page/dataset/app/book/mapping 五个 packaged-base 访问器的注释合并为一份共享契约，逐条保留原有陈述，文件现为 11704 行，`check:facade-delegation-only` 通过，未改上限台账。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`（`mappings` 分组与拒收文案），`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateMapping`（D2 标签顺序），`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` 新行。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`，预期 1365/1365 通过，其中 zh-CN 读 `/meta/mappings` 得到 `线索导入`，en-US 得到 `Lead feed`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**
  - New optional translation group `mappings` (keyed by mapping `name`, one key `label`) on `TranslationDataSchema`, `PlatformTranslationDataSchema`, `ServedTranslationDataSchema` and `TranslationItemSchema`.
  - The group is a strict object. `description` and `fieldMapping` are refused with guidance that names where to translate instead (a target field's label is `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.label`). The singular `mapping` and the label aliases `name` / `title` are refused with the declared spelling named. The group counts in the refusal texts moved from sixteen to seventeen (application) and from seventeen to eighteen (platform).
  - New `translateMapping`, registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`. `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is derived from that table, so `GET /meta/mapping` (list and item) is localized at the REST boundary with no further wiring. The label follows the ADR-0146 D2 order (`labelCatalogs` / `valueOverridesPackagedBase`), like `translateBook`.
  - `MappingSchema.label`'s `.describe` names the translation key.
  - Generated files are regenerated: authorable surface (build-written), api-surface, export-origins, the references docs, the liveness ledger (`mappings` live, with its `label` child) and the strictness-ledger counts.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` / `@objectstack/rest`:** `mapping` joins `PackagedArtifactBaseType`. `getPackagedMappingBase` is on the protocol, forwarding to the facet. A `['mapping', 'getPackagedMappingBase']` row goes in `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS`. A `.custom` override's label is therefore judged against the shipped base, not read as override-authored.
- **`@objectstack/lint`:**
  - The i18n walk emits `mappings.NAME.label` (source `mapping`).
  - `validate-translation-references` resolves `mappings.NAME` against the stack's mappings and sibling packages' mappings. An unknown name is `translation-target-unknown` with the nearest name suggested.
  - The rule explanation names the group.
- **`@objectstack/cli`:** `os i18n check` reports gaps as `i18n/missing-mapping`. `--help` names "import mappings".
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` / `@object-ui/i18n`:**
  - The translation preview shows the group as Import Mappings (导入映射).
  - The Studio translation table walks `mapping` items.
  - `spec-translations` namespaces the group.
- **Showcase:** zh-CN translates `showcase_inquiry_feed`, the one mapping any example authors.
- **Docs:** `i18n-standard.mdx` (group list and count), `ui/translations.mdx` (a row, and the resolved-types list), `import-mappings.mdx` (the `label` row names the key).
- **Platform checklist** (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/i18n.json`, the file added in L1 round 1): item `i18n.surface-matrix` moves to revision 16.
  - `acceptance[7].clause` now counts eighteen platform groups, seventeen per-app groups and seventeen scored groups, and names `mappings` in the list. Before, a tester would have scored the showcase's `mappings.showcase_inquiry_feed` as outside the vocabulary.
  - The `appTranslationDataShape` source line names all seventeen app groups. It used to say fifteen and leave out `hooks`, which was stale before this PR.
  - The history entry records a count-and-list correction with no change to the clause's meaning.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-mapping.test.ts` (new):
  - all four doors accept the group;
  - the face is closed;
  - the aliases are refused;
  - the `description` / `fieldMapping` guidance is shown;
  - `translateMapping` is registered;
  - zh-CN reads the translation and en-US gets the same reference back;
  - the locale ladder and fallback chain apply;
  - an empty label is not a translation;
  - the input is not mutated.
- `i18n-resolver.test.ts`: a `mapping` row in the ADR-0146 D2 precedence table (now "all nine types").
- REST: the accessor pin and a `mapping` precedence row. objectql: the bare-slot envelope test's label-order types gain `mapping`.
- Runtime: the meta list projection parity census carries `mapping` / `mappings`. Over HTTP, zh-CN `/meta/mappings` serves `线索导入` and en-US `/meta/mapping` serves `Lead feed`. The item read is pinned too.
- Lint: the walk emits the key from the label only, never from the field mapping. `validate-translation-references` covers four cases: a clean name, an orphan with a suggestion, a report name under `mappings`, and a sibling-declared name.
- CLI, `test/i18n-mapping-walk.test.ts` (new): the extract keys, a schema-valid scaffold, and a gap reported as `source: 'mapping'`.
- UI: the preview category tests (one entry per group; the coverage denominator goes from 2/16 to 2/17) and the translation table's list-read count (15).
- Ablation, two legs, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1/1; restore proven as blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - dropping `mapping: translateMapping` from the dispatch table fails 9 tests and passes 541 (`i18n-mapping` and the D2 rows);
  - dropping the `mappings` row from the orphan table fails 2 tests and passes 252.

## Acceptance notes

- **The facade line ceiling is paid inside `protocol.ts` (seat ruling, route B).** The per-accessor docblocks of `getPackagedPageBase`, `getPackagedDatasetBase`, `getPackagedAppBase`, `getPackagedBookBase` and the new `getPackagedMappingBase` are folded into one shared contract on `getPackagedPageBase`. That contract names all five accessors. The other four each carry a one-line pointer to it. `protocol.ts` is now 11704 lines against its ceiling of 11705, with the forwarder in. `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` is untouched. Where each folded statement now lives:

  | Statement (before the fold) | Was on | Now in the shared docblock |
  |:---|:---|:---|
  | `[#30062]`; the PACKAGED (code-layer) declaration a code package ships, before a `.custom` pair's declared override replaces it (ADR-0146 D2) | page (each of dataset, app, book carried `[#30062]`) | opening sentence, for all five |
  | the page is the twin of `getPackagedDashboardBase`, answered the same way | page | "the page is the twin of `getPackagedDashboardBase`" |
  | dataset, app and book are twins of `getPackagedPageBase`, and mapping of `getPackagedBookBase`, answered the same way | dataset, app, book, mapping | "the other four are twins of the page (and of each other), all answered the same way" |
  | the fact the translator (`@objectstack/spec/system`) compares against as its `packagedBase`; the catalog is the packaged translation of exactly this body, so it may only replace a string the served item still carries unchanged (ruling record 6631250894: pair, then the override's own label, then the base's translation) | page | shared paragraph, for all five |
  | `translatePage`, `pages.NAME` | page | page bullet |
  | measured: the `crm_welcome` override labelled `OVpage` was served, and zh-CN got the base's `欢迎页` | page | page bullet |
  | a page has no extension fold, so the artifact item IS the packaged declaration | page | page bullet (page only) |
  | `translateDataset`, each string of `datasets.NAME` (label, description, dimension and measure labels) | dataset | dataset bullet |
  | same reason as the page: a pair's dataset override kept the base's translated label and measure labels over its own | dataset | dataset bullet |
  | `translateApp`, each string of `apps.NAME` (label, description and navigation labels, a node judged against the base's node of the same `id`) | app | app bullet |
  | `translateBook`, each string of `books.NAME` (label, description and group labels, a group judged against the base's group of the same `key`) | book | book bullet |
  | `translateMapping` compares the served label (`mappings.NAME.label`, ADR-0146 D2) | mapping | mapping bullet (with #34939); ADR-0146 D2 is in the opening sentence |
  | shadow-immune for the dashboard's reason: served from its row, never as the artifact, so the body is the base's own | page | closing paragraph, for all five |
  | returns `undefined` for an item no code package ships, an unknown or empty name, or a registry double without the lookup, which the translator reads as the catalog applying unchanged ("the same uncertainties" for the other four) | page, with the others pointing to it | closing paragraph, for all five |
- `description` stays out (seat ruling): `MappingSchema` declares none.
- **Other spelled group counts and lists.** At `f23f65d8c8` the tree was grepped over `docs/qa`, `content/docs`, `scripts`, `packages`, `ui`, `examples` and `skills`. Every spelled translation-group count or list either is correct (`i18n-standard.mdx`, `translation.zod.ts`) or was fixed above (`i18n.json`). Two places were left alone:
  - `scripts/check-i18n-walk-parity.mjs`'s `RECORDED_*` arrays are a declared sample, not a source of truth;
  - `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` stays with #34962.
- The changeset's Clause-② line now names `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedMappingBase` (L1 N1).
- `skills/**` is untouched. The group list in `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` is owed on #34962.
